entries.definition_en: words you say to someone on their birthday
entries.example_en: Happy birthday, Mai! This gift is for you.
entries.example_vi: Chúc mừng sinh nhật Mai! Quà này tặng bạn.

entries.definition_en: to have the same face or body as someone
entries.example_en: Nam looks like his father.
entries.example_vi: Nam trông giống bố.

entries.definition_en: the part of your face that you see with
entries.example_en: My baby sister has big brown eyes.
entries.example_vi: Em gái nhỏ của mình có đôi mắt nâu to.

entries.definition_en: the people in your home: parents, brothers and sisters
entries.example_en: There are five people in my family.
entries.example_vi: Gia đình mình có năm người.

entries.definition_en: the friend you like the most
entries.example_en: Lan is my best friend at school.
entries.example_vi: Lan là bạn thân của mình ở trường.

entries.definition_en: an adult male person
entries.example_en: The man in the blue shirt is my uncle.
entries.example_vi: Người đàn ông mặc áo xanh là chú mình.

entries.definition_en: to become older, from a child to an adult
entries.example_en: Kids grow up very fast.
entries.example_vi: Trẻ con lớn nhanh lắm.

entries.definition_en: your mother
entries.example_en: My mom cooks dinner for the family.
entries.example_vi: Mẹ mình nấu bữa tối cho cả nhà.

entries.definition_en: a child with no brothers or sisters
entries.example_en: Minh is an only child.
entries.example_vi: Minh là con một.

entries.definition_en: to become husband and wife
entries.example_en: My aunt gets married in spring.
entries.example_vi: Dì mình cưới vào mùa xuân.

entries.definition_en: having lived for many years
entries.example_en: My grandpa is old, but he is very strong.
entries.example_vi: Ông mình đã già nhưng vẫn rất khỏe.

entries.definition_en: a very young child
entries.example_en: The baby sleeps a lot in the day.
entries.example_vi: Em bé ngủ rất nhiều vào ban ngày.

entries.definition_en: to look after someone or something
entries.example_en: My grandma takes care of my baby brother.
entries.example_vi: Bà mình chăm em trai nhỏ của mình.

entries.definition_en: a male child
entries.example_en: The boy plays soccer with his friends.
entries.example_vi: Cậu bé chơi bóng đá với các bạn.

entries.definition_en: a female child
entries.example_en: The girl with long hair is my cousin.
entries.example_vi: Cô bé tóc dài là em họ của mình.

entries.definition_en: father
entries.example_en: My dad takes me to school by motorbike.
entries.example_vi: Bố chở mình đi học bằng xe máy.

entries.definition_en: the part at the end of your arm
entries.example_en: Wash your hands before you eat.
entries.example_vi: Rửa tay trước khi ăn nhé.

entries.definition_en: to have your home in a place
entries.example_en: My family lives in a small house in Hue.
entries.example_vi: Gia đình mình sống trong một ngôi nhà nhỏ ở Huế.

entries.definition_en: higher than most people
entries.example_en: My brother is very tall for his age.
entries.example_vi: Anh mình rất cao so với tuổi.

entries.definition_en: to do a job to get money
entries.example_en: My parents work in a hospital.
entries.example_vi: Bố mẹ mình làm việc ở bệnh viện.

entries.definition_en: a young boy or girl
entries.example_en: Every child in our village goes to school.
entries.example_vi: Mọi đứa trẻ trong làng mình đều được đi học.

entries.definition_en: an adult female person
entries.example_en: The woman at the door is our new teacher.
entries.example_vi: Người phụ nữ ở cửa là cô giáo mới của tụi mình.

entries.definition_en: not old; born not many years ago
entries.example_en: My aunt is young and very kind.
entries.example_vi: Dì mình còn trẻ và rất tốt bụng.

entries.definition_en: a group of people like parents and their children
entries.example_en: Our family eats dinner together every night.
entries.example_vi: Tối nào cả nhà mình cũng ăn cơm cùng nhau.

entries.definition_en: a man who has a child
entries.example_en: Her father is a teacher at my school.
entries.example_vi: Bố của bạn ấy là thầy giáo ở trường mình.

entries.definition_en: a person you know well and like
entries.example_en: I play badminton with my friends after school.
entries.example_vi: Tan học, mình chơi cầu lông với bạn bè.

entries.definition_en: a woman who has a child
entries.example_en: My mother gets up early every morning.
entries.example_vi: Mẹ mình dậy sớm mỗi sáng.

entries.definition_en: men, women and children
entries.example_en: Many people go to the market on Sunday.
entries.example_vi: Chủ nhật có rất nhiều người đi chợ.

entries.definition_en: a girl or woman who has the same parents as you
entries.example_en: My sister is two years older than me.
entries.example_vi: Chị mình lớn hơn mình hai tuổi.

entries.definition_en: a boy or man who has the same parents as you
entries.example_en: My little brother likes to draw cars.
entries.example_vi: Em trai mình thích vẽ ô tô.

entries.definition_en: the day of the year when you were born
entries.example_en: My birthday is in May.
entries.example_vi: Sinh nhật của mình vào tháng Năm.

entries.definition_en: how old someone is
entries.example_en: Lan and I are the same age.
entries.example_vi: Lan và mình bằng tuổi nhau.

entries.definition_en: the long part of your body between your hand and shoulder
entries.example_en: My dad has strong arms.
entries.example_vi: Bố mình có đôi tay khỏe.

entries.definition_en: the part of your head that you hear with
entries.example_en: Our dog has long, soft ears.
entries.example_vi: Con chó nhà mình có đôi tai dài và mềm.

entries.definition_en: the work you do to get money
entries.example_en: My aunt has a new job in a bank.
entries.example_vi: Dì mình có việc mới ở ngân hàng.

entries.definition_en: a child
entries.example_en: The kids play football in the street.
entries.example_vi: Bọn trẻ đá bóng ngoài đường.

entries.definition_en: the long part of your body you walk on
entries.example_en: My leg hurts after the long walk.
entries.example_vi: Chân mình đau sau chuyến đi bộ dài.

entries.definition_en: a parent's boy child
entries.example_en: My uncle has two sons and a daughter.
entries.example_vi: Chú mình có hai con trai và một con gái.

entries.definition_en: the sister of your mother or father
entries.example_en: My aunt makes the best spring rolls.
entries.example_vi: Dì mình làm nem rán ngon nhất.

entries.definition_en: all of a person or animal
entries.example_en: Sports are good for your body.
entries.example_vi: Thể thao tốt cho cơ thể.

entries.definition_en: small and nice to look at
entries.example_en: My cousin has a cute little dog.
entries.example_vi: Em họ mình có một chú chó nhỏ dễ thương.

entries.definition_en: the front of your head, with your eyes, nose and mouth
entries.example_en: Wash your face before you go to bed.
entries.example_vi: Rửa mặt trước khi đi ngủ nhé.

entries.definition_en: the thin lines that grow on your head
entries.example_en: My sister has long black hair.
entries.example_vi: Chị mình có mái tóc đen dài.

entries.definition_en: the top part of your body, above your neck
entries.example_en: Put your hat on your head. It's sunny.
entries.example_vi: Đội mũ lên đầu đi. Trời nắng đấy.

entries.definition_en: to feel pain, or to make someone feel pain
entries.example_en: My tooth hurts when I eat ice cream.
entries.example_vi: Răng mình đau khi ăn kem.

entries.definition_en: the part of your face you smell with
entries.example_en: The clown has a big red nose.
entries.example_vi: Chú hề có cái mũi đỏ to.

entries.definition_en: not well; having an illness
entries.example_en: Nam is sick, so he stays home today.
entries.example_vi: Nam bị ốm nên hôm nay ở nhà.

entries.definition_en: the woman a man is married to
entries.example_en: My uncle and his wife live in Da Nang.
entries.example_vi: Chú mình và vợ sống ở Đà Nẵng.

entries.definition_en: a job, or the place where you do your job
entries.example_en: My mom goes to work by bus.
entries.example_vi: Mẹ mình đi làm bằng xe buýt.

entries.definition_en: the part of your face you eat and talk with
entries.example_en: Open your mouth, please, said the doctor.
entries.example_vi: Bác sĩ bảo: Cháu há miệng ra nào.

entries.definition_en: a time when people meet to eat, talk and have fun
entries.example_en: We have a big party for Grandma's birthday.
entries.example_vi: Cả nhà làm tiệc lớn mừng sinh nhật bà.

entries.definition_en: not tall
entries.example_en: I am short, but I can run fast.
entries.example_vi: Mình thấp nhưng chạy rất nhanh.

entries.definition_en: quick to learn and understand
entries.example_en: Minh is smart and good at math.
entries.example_vi: Minh thông minh và giỏi toán.

entries.definition_en: one of the hard white things in your mouth
entries.example_en: Brush your teeth after every meal.
entries.example_vi: Đánh răng sau mỗi bữa ăn nhé.

entries.definition_en: the brother of your mother or father
entries.example_en: My uncle drives a taxi in Hanoi.
entries.example_vi: Chú mình lái taxi ở Hà Nội.

entries.definition_en: the child of your aunt or uncle
entries.example_en: My cousin and I go to the same school.
entries.example_vi: Em họ và mình học cùng trường.

entries.definition_en: a person whose job is to help sick people get well
entries.example_en: My mom takes me to the doctor.
entries.example_vi: Mẹ đưa mình đi khám bác sĩ.

entries.definition_en: a mother or father
entries.example_en: My parents work very hard for us.
entries.example_vi: Bố mẹ làm việc rất vất vả vì tụi mình.

entries.definition_en: a man, woman or child
entries.example_en: Lan is a kind person.
entries.example_vi: Lan là một người tốt bụng.

entries.definition_en: nice to look at
entries.example_en: My sister looks pretty in her ao dai.
entries.example_vi: Chị mình mặc áo dài trông thật xinh.

entries.definition_en: a person who sings, often as a job
entries.example_en: My cousin wants to be a singer.
entries.example_vi: Em họ mình muốn trở thành ca sĩ.

entries.definition_en: having a lot of power in your body
entries.example_en: My grandpa is strong. He can carry a big bag.
entries.example_vi: Ông mình khỏe lắm, xách được cả túi to.

entries.definition_en: your father's or mother's mother
entries.example_en: Grandma tells us stories after dinner.
entries.example_vi: Sau bữa tối bà kể chuyện cho tụi mình nghe.

entries.definition_en: your father's or mother's father
entries.example_en: Grandpa waters the plants every morning.
entries.example_vi: Sáng nào ông cũng tưới cây.

entries.definition_en: strong and not sick
entries.example_en: Eat fruit and vegetables to stay healthy.
entries.example_vi: Ăn rau và hoa quả để luôn khỏe mạnh.

entries.definition_en: the man a woman is married to
entries.example_en: My aunt and her husband have a small shop.
entries.example_vi: Cô mình và chồng có một cửa hàng nhỏ.

entries.definition_en: a parent's girl child
entries.example_en: Mr. Nam has one daughter.
entries.example_vi: Chú Nam có một cô con gái.

entries.definition_en: a person who lives near you
entries.example_en: Our neighbor gives us some fruit.
entries.example_vi: Hàng xóm cho nhà mình ít hoa quả.

entries.definition_en: with each other
entries.example_en: My family watches TV together every evening.
entries.example_vi: Tối nào cả nhà mình cũng xem TV cùng nhau.

entries.definition_en: very nice to look at
entries.example_en: My mom has a beautiful smile.
entries.example_vi: Mẹ mình có nụ cười rất đẹp.

entries.definition_en: the father of your mother or father
entries.example_en: My grandfather was a farmer in the countryside.
entries.example_vi: Ông mình từng là nông dân ở quê.

entries.definition_en: the mother of your mother or father
entries.example_en: My grandmother lives with us in the city.
entries.example_vi: Bà mình sống cùng nhà mình ở thành phố.

entries.definition_en: a man or boy
entries.example_en: Nam is a nice guy. Everyone likes him.
entries.example_vi: Nam là một anh chàng tốt, ai cũng quý.

entries.definition_en: not wanting to work or do anything
entries.example_en: On Sunday morning, I feel lazy and stay in bed.
entries.example_vi: Sáng Chủ nhật mình thấy lười nên nằm lì trên giường.

entries.definition_en: the time when a person is alive, or the way they live
entries.example_en: My grandparents have a quiet life in the countryside.
entries.example_vi: Ông bà mình sống một cuộc sống yên bình ở quê.

entries.definition_en: the part of the body between your head and shoulders
entries.example_en: Wear a scarf around your neck in winter.
entries.example_vi: Mùa đông nhớ quàng khăn quanh cổ nhé.

entries.definition_en: having very little money
entries.example_en: We give old clothes to poor families.
entries.example_vi: Nhà mình tặng quần áo cũ cho các gia đình nghèo.

entries.definition_en: having a lot of money
entries.example_en: The rich man gives money to the school.
entries.example_vi: Người đàn ông giàu có tặng tiền cho trường học.

entries.definition_en: having a narrow body
entries.example_en: My brother is tall and thin.
entries.example_vi: Anh mình cao và gầy.

entries.definition_en: a word children use for their father
entries.example_en: Daddy, can you read me a story?
entries.example_vi: Bố ơi, bố đọc truyện cho con nghe nhé?

entries.definition_en: a person you invite to your home or a party
entries.example_en: We have three guests for dinner tonight.
entries.example_vi: Tối nay nhà mình có ba vị khách đến ăn tối.

entries.definition_en: a word children use for their mother
entries.example_en: Mommy, I want some milk, please.
entries.example_vi: Mẹ ơi, cho con xin ít sữa ạ.

entries.definition_en: quick to learn and good at finding answers
entries.example_en: The clever boy fixes his bike by himself.
entries.example_vi: Cậu bé lanh lợi tự sửa xe đạp của mình.

entries.definition_en: the person you live with or are married to
entries.example_en: My aunt lives with her partner in Da Nang.
entries.example_vi: Cô mình sống cùng bạn đời ở Đà Nẵng.

entries.definition_en: nice to look at (for a man or boy)
entries.example_en: My uncle looks handsome in his new shirt.
entries.example_vi: Chú mình mặc áo mới trông đẹp trai lắm.

entries.definition_en: a boy or man you love and go out with
entries.example_en: My cousin's boyfriend is very funny.
entries.example_vi: Bạn trai của chị họ mình rất vui tính.

entries.definition_en: to do something fun on a special day
entries.example_en: We celebrate Tet with our grandparents.
entries.example_vi: Nhà mình đón Tết cùng ông bà.

entries.definition_en: a girl or woman you love and go out with
entries.example_en: Nam takes his girlfriend to the cinema.
entries.example_vi: Nam đưa bạn gái đi xem phim.

entries.meaning_vi: buổi ăn mừng, lễ kỷ niệm
entries.definition_en: a special event or party for a happy day
entries.example_en: The wedding celebration is at a big restaurant.
entries.example_vi: Tiệc cưới tổ chức ở một nhà hàng lớn.

entries.definition_en: a parent of your mother or father
entries.example_en: My grandparents live in the countryside.
entries.example_vi: Ông bà mình sống ở quê.
